reports.title: IRADIMED CORPORATION Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects revenue of $25.0 million to $26.5 million, GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.53 to $0.57, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.57 to $0.61. For the full year 2026, the Company expects to report revenue of $91.6 million to $93.1 million, GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.90 to $1.94, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $2.07 to $2.11.

The Company’s non-GAAP diluted earnings per share guidance excludes stock-based compensation expense, net of tax expense. The Company expects stock-based compensation expense, net of tax, to be approximately $2.5 million and $0.6 million for the full year and third quarter of 2026, respectively.
